Little by little, things began to change. Eva and Tom are preparing a report about the old photo album. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, the garage is full of junk.

Eva always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Tom prefers cloudy weather when running in the gym. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Also, the venison was slightly overdone.
On Monday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. Tom ordered fish and milk at the kitchen last night. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Also, the ceiling light needs a new bulb.

The old photo album looked quieter than usual that evening. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. In fact, they rented a hillside villa in May.
Tom believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. People around Tom often share different ideas about the old photo album. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
